tool_input.args: Animation-arc proposals for BloomInPlacePrototype — establishing posture before lens-check investigation into the three proposed fixes (identity fix, tap-down scaling, MorphPresentationController port). Reference video: _frames/updated_bloom.mov. Existing Tier-3B controller is wired but the bloomed-view structural state mutates synchronously, no modal-tray rise, no tap-down response. We need to ground in the actual video + ResortPassApp's transitions before committing to an approach.
